name: Melissa Croden
event: UFC Fight Night: Buckley vs. Malott
summary: A tall (5'10") Calgary-based bantamweight (8-3, 2-1 UFC, No. 15 per one preview) who wins with pressure, volume and ground-and-pound that builds round by round. Seven of her eight wins are stoppages and most came late; she has never been finished.

how_they_fight.Striking: Long, kick-heavy at range (leg kicks, front kicks, hard body kick that hurt Luana Santos) and a swarming, volume-based pressure game when she smells blood; landed 99 of 175 significant strikes and scored a knockdown against Tainara Lisboa.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Clinch-and-trip attacker who finishes from top with ground-and-pound (Lisboa, nearly Zheleznyakova); threatened a standing arm-triangle against Zheleznyakova. Takes the back in scrambles but struggled to escape Santos's scarf hold.
how_they_fight.Defense: Fends off most shots (stopped six of Lisboa's eight takedowns) but a strong wrestler can hold her down: Santos took her down three times for over nine minutes of control. Gets bloodied early but has never been stopped.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Classic slow burner. Of seven stoppage wins: four in round 3 (Maisonnueve, Holm, Lehner, Lisboa at 4:32), two in round 2, one in round 1. Often gives up round one (Lisboa and Zheleznyakova both had the better of R1) then takes over; was seconds from a R3 TKO against Zheleznyakova. All three losses are decisions (two 3-round, one 5-round) - never finished.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Composed and adaptable mid-fight; switches from range kicking to clinch pressure when needed. Weakness is falling behind early and being out-grappled by a positional wrestler.

patterns: Slow start, strong finish: 4 of 7 stoppages in round 3
Volume and pressure increase as opponents fade
Never finished; losses all on the scorecards
Fights well in Canada (Vancouver and Winnipeg wins)
concerns: Bottom position against a heavy top grappler (Santos loss)
keys_to_beat: Win round one and wrestle her: takedowns plus top control
Avoid a firefight in round three when she is at her best
Clinch to smother her range kicking

news.text: Booked against Chelsea Chandler at UFC Edmonton; her second Canadian appearance of 2026.
Beat Darya Zheleznyakova by unanimous decision (29-28 x3) in Winnipeg, her first career decision win; made weight easily (135.5).
Official weigh-in: her weight is blank in the published results (UFC.com and Cageside Press); opponent Chandler weighed 135.5 and no miss, cancellation or catchweight was reported for the bout.
